entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I... I need to return something. My order number is VF88602.
Okay, I can help with that. Let me pull up order VF88602... I see a pair of ProLite cycling shoes. Is that correct?
Yes, that's them. I just... they're not working out. I feel terrible about it, I was so excited for them.
I'm sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's the fit. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and never had a problem, but these... they give me awful blisters every time I ride more than a few miles. I've tried everything.
Blisters are definitely not what we want for our customers. I understand that's frustrating.

It really is. I even took them to a shop to get the cleats adjusted perfectly, thinking that was the problem, but it didn't help. I honestly just need the money back right now. It was a big purchase for me.
I understand completely. Let me just check your purchase date... Okay, I see you received the order 63 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window.
Wait, really? I thought I might be too late.

Not at all. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on your account. Just package the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop them at any post office.
Oh, that's such a relief. Thank you so, so much, Charlie. You have no idea how much this helps.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for being so helpful.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
